vulnerable_code:
@router.get("/auth/magic-link/verify")
async def verify_magic_link_token(
    token: str = Query(...),
    target_user_id: uuid.UUID = Query(...),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    stmt = select(MagicLoginToken).where(
        MagicLoginToken.token_hash == hash_token(token),
        MagicLoginToken.expires_at > datetime.utcnow(),
        MagicLoginToken.is_consumed == False
    )
    token_record = await db.scalar(stmt)
    if not token_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid or expired magic link")

    token_record.is_consumed = True
    await db.commit()

    session_jwt = create_access_token(data={"sub": str(target_user_id), "auth_method": "magic_link"})
    return {"access_token": session_jwt, "token_type": "bearer"}
diagnosis: The magic link verification endpoint validates that token is active and unconsumed, but creates an access token using target_user_id supplied in the query string rather than the user ID bound to token_record. An attacker with any valid magic link can impersonate any target_user_id on the platform.
corrected_code:
@router.get("/auth/magic-link/verify")
async def verify_magic_link_token(
    token: str = Query(...),
    target_user_id: uuid.UUID = Query(...),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    stmt = select(MagicLoginToken).where(
        MagicLoginToken.token_hash == hash_token(token),
        MagicLoginToken.expires_at > datetime.utcnow(),
        MagicLoginToken.is_consumed == False
    )
    token_record = await db.scalar(stmt)
    if not token_record or token_record.user_id != target_user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid magic link or user mismatch")

    token_record.is_consumed = True
    await db.commit()

    session_jwt = create_access_token(data={"sub": str(token_record.user_id), "auth_method": "magic_link"})
    return {"access_token": session_jwt, "token_type": "bearer"}
